newsitem.title: FRANCE: Hachette Livre set to buy art book firm - source.
newsitem.headline: Hachette Livre set to buy art book firm - source.

text.p: Hachette Livre, the book publishing branch of Lagardere conglomerate, is preparing to buy the French art book firm Hazan, a source in the publishing industry said on Thursday.
Hachette will buy 99 percent of Hazan and leave the remaining one percent in the hands of owner and manager Eric Hazan, the source said.

A spokesman at Lagardere confirmed that the group was in talks with Hazan, which has experienced financial difficulties. "There are talks going on," the spokesman told Reuters. He declined to say whether the two sides were close to striking a deal.
